title: Initial Positioning of Left Sided Double Lumen Endobronchial Tubes Using Peak Inspiratory Pressures Difference Between Two Lungs
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to investigate a performance of initial positioning of left sided double lumen endobronchial tubes using peak inspiratory pressures difference between two lungs.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ASA physical status class I, II
* Use of double lumen tube
* Normal preoperative pulmonary function study

Exclusion Criteria:

* COPD
* Restrictive lung disease
* CAOD
* Unstable hemodynamic status
* Peak inspiratory pressure \> 30 mm Hg (Two lung ventilation)
